Top-line: large healthcare payments processor with PCI + HIPAA obligations. Support org ~1k agents, global PSTN + chat. Primary ask: agent assist (tool-calling + secure tool integrations), ticket summarization, and reliability during batch-bill cycles (spike windows).

Discovery highlights:
- Needs private deployment in customer VPC; will not accept public hosted API for PHI flows.
- "We cannot have any model outputs logged outside our environment" — security lead (M. Ortega).
- Retention policy: 7 years for billing transcripts; need configurable retention + purge controls.
- SSO: SAML + SCIM provisioning required for agent-level auditing.
- KMS: customer-managed keys (HSM preferred) + key rotation proof.
- Audit: immutable audit logs, exportable to Splunk/Datadog.
- Performance targets: P50 latency < 150ms for autocomplete/intent classification; P95 < 400ms for multi-turn assist; throughput target 1200 concurrent agent sessions during peak billing runs.
- Cost sensitivity: willing to buy reserved capacity for predictable bill-run spikes; looking for quantization + batching recommendations.
